title: Alveolar ridge augmentation by open healing with high -density polytetrafluoroethylene membrane Cvetanovska
authors: Stojcheva D, Aleksandrovska A, Petrevska M, Micevski B. International Journal of Dental Biomaterials Research. 2022 Mar;1(1).
supports: Clinical study from the botiss permamem (dense PTFE) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “, the high -density polytetrafluoroethylene membrane efficiently supported open healing and led to successful alveolar ridge augmentation” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
